question: Should CLI URL-only generated-video downloads use the shared provider HTTP SSRF guard, causing private/internal asset URLs to fail closed unless the selected provider sets request.allowPrivateNetwork?
rationale: The code shape matches the existing provider request guard, but it deliberately changes upgrade behavior for private/internal URL-only generated-video assets at a security boundary.

options.title: Accept Guarded Downloads
options.body: Land after exact-head checks while owning that private/internal URL-only generated-video downloads now require the existing provider request opt-in.

options.title: Require Compatibility Adjustment
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-approved compatibility path or operator-facing guidance before accepting the private-network behavior change.

options.title: Hold For Broader Generated-Media Policy
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want one shared generated-media download policy before changing only the CLI video path.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Downloads
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head checks while owning that private/internal URL-only generated-video downloads now require the existing provider request opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is tied to both the recent CLI generated-video URL hardening and the shared provider HTTP request shaping seam.
